narrativeSection.heading: Research and building dermatology services
narrativeSection.text: Aileen Chang's UCSF Department of Dermatology biography describes research on how social and structural factors shape the development, clinical presentation, and treatment of skin conditions. It also describes her interdisciplinary work on lymphedema and wound care, and dermatology capacity in low-resource settings. From 2017 to 2024, she served as founding director of the ZSFG Dermatology Consult Service. This is the department's account of her work, not verified patient outcomes or a current appointment offer.

section.heading: From laboratory research to dentistry
section.text: Browning's first-person biography says her interest in science led her to dentistry. The account describes studying biology at UCLA and spending three years in hematology and oncology research involving recombinant DNA and stem cells before she chose dentistry. It also says she enjoys travel and completed three Spartan races with her husband; the source's relative timing is undated, so no calendar year is supplied. These details are attributed to her practice biography, not independent clinical findings.
